top_band: blue-grey tiled roof slope (rows 1-14) above roof overhang and stone basin with visible top rim and water surface (rows 29-35)
evidence: The structure clearly shows a 14px tall foreshortened roof slope (rows 1-14) with ridge cap, eave shadow (rows 15-17), support pillars (rows 17-43), and a stone water basin at the base showing a 7px top surface with an inset water opening (rows 30-34) above a 7px front face (rows 36-42).

style.evidence: While the roof has decent tile shading, the wooden pillars (rows 17-43) are completely flat 2-colour vertical stripes with no wood grain, and the stone basin front face (rows 37-42) is a large 12x6 solid flat grey rectangle with zero stone texture, enclosed in a heavy near-black outline. Much flatter than the Beodeul well reference.
